## Why This Is Asked
Tests production-grade privacy-aware ML design on GCP, focusing on multi-tenant isolation, secure aggregation, and staged rollouts with governance.

## Key Concepts
- Privacy-preserving cross-tenant training with secure aggregation

- Regional data partitions and in-country residency

- Data provenance in BigQuery and cost governance

steps:
  - ingest_region:

      sink: gs://bucket/region/us-west-1
